**Classic renderer no longer crashes when you switch to it.** Changing the
Renderer option from Accelerated 3D to Classic software in the middle of a
game could stop DOOM with an "R_MapPlane" error. While drawing floors and
ceilings, the classic renderer looks one column past each edge. Original
DOOM kept that column filled with safe values. This port's growable floor
list started new entries with leftover memory instead, and a stray value
there pointed below the bottom of the screen. New entries now start out
cleared, the way the original's did.
